value.rationale: The 34 paired disconnected sectors within individually identical linear conserved charge classes establish a substantive and motivated obstruction to classifying quantum-dimer kinetic fragmentation by binary face charges alone. The exact 69-versus-14 RK ground-state multiplicity change is a natural physical consequence, independent of the already-known total matching count, and supplies a finite quantum-network benchmark.
